result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits, applies cyber coverage to Garman’s processing of Sparkling’s data, requires statutory workers’ compensation, and provides certificates on request. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is unnecessary, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. The new provision should also be separately numbered for cleaner integration into Section 20. The existing unrelated language remains unchanged.
